draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Pattadakal! This cluster of 7th and 8th century temples on the Malaprabha River is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, praised as a blend of north and south Indian temple styles.
draft.hungryLine: My notes don't list any eateries in this small town, so carry water and snacks, especially in the hot months.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Virupaksha temple and Papanatha Temple are just a 2 min walk away, and Galaganatha Temple is about 3 min further.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Wander down towards the Malaprabha River, the temples sit right on its west bank.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Digs at nearby Bachinagudda found evidence of Iron Age megalithic habitation here for the first time.

spots.name: Virupaksha temple
spots.detail: 2 min walk · Part of the UNESCO-listed Chalukya group

spots.name: Galaganatha Temple
spots.detail: 3 min walk · Another of the 7th and 8th century temples

spots.name: Jain Narayana Temple
spots.detail: Away from the main group · A 9th century Jain temple

tips.title: Skip the April to June heat.
tips.body: Summer temperatures here peak over 40 C, while winter sits between 15 and 28 C.

tips.title: Pair it with Aihole and Badami.
tips.body: Aihole is about 9.7 km away and Badami about 23 km, both big Chalukya centres.

story.title: First settlers
story.body: Megalithic dolmens show people lived here in prehistoric times, drawn by the red soil and stone hills by the river.

story.title: A brick temple
story.body: At Bachinagudda, digs found an early brick temple from before the Chalukyas, with a 16-pillared hall and a four-faced Shiva head.

story.title: The Chalukya temples
story.body: The Chalukya dynasty built nine Hindu temples and one Jain temple here. Their friezes tell stories from the Ramayana, the Mahabharata and the Panchatantra.

story.title: A Jain temple
story.body: The Jain Narayana Temple went up in the 9th century under the Rashtrakuta king Krishna II.

story.title: World heritage
story.body: Pattadakal is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, protected and managed by the Archaeological Survey of India.
